What Wood is

Wood is an independent TUNG modding toolkit. Its included mods cover world speed, game utilities, and Coordinates for a live position readout.

How it works

A pinned UE4SS loader starts WoodRuntime inside the game. Wood creates Unreal UMG widgets for its menu and settings. The runtime scans standalone Lua files in the game’s Mods folder and stores preferences separately from game saves.

What is included

  • A single-file setup executable and in-game mod menu.
  • Native menus and settings accessible with F10.
  • Wood Utilities: auto-speedrunner mode, application volume, and mouse controls.
  • Time Warp world-speed controls from 0.05× to 4×.
  • Coordinates: a configurable live coordinate overlay.
  • A standalone launcher and installed uninstaller.
  • Official mod collection and a documented settings API.

Release status

Version 2.2.3 includes Wood Utilities and the standalone Coordinates mod. Installation and restoration are covered by regression tests. Time dilation and native widget controls were verified in the installed game during development. Compatibility with future TUNG releases is not guaranteed.

The executables are currently unsigned. This release has no automatic updater, input recording, or replay system.

Open development

Wood’s own source is prepared as a local Git repository with an MIT license, build instructions, and GitHub Actions release workflow. Public GitHub publication is pending. The UE4SS runtime retains its own upstream license.
